description: Reference C++→.NET-8 scaffold for fmt-style format APIs: a primary template that takes a compile-time-checked format string plus a variadic pack of typed arguments. The .NET projection lowers `template<typename ...Args>` to a `params object?[]` overload alongside a strongly-typed `Format<T>` for the common integral / floating-point cases. Every public surface carries `[SpecClaim(...)]` attributes citing the signed spec's INV / OL / TI / UB / EX claim ids, so reviewers can trace each contract back to the spec without leaving the IDE.

matches.fallback: Used when the routine sits inside fmt::* and exposes a format-string-plus-args API surface.
